title: Postgresql Architecture Wal Files |Write Ahead Log | Learnomate Technologies | Ankush Sir
description:
In the realm of database management systems, PostgreSQL stands out as a robust and versatile option, renowned for its reliability and performance. Central to its architecture are Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) files, a critical component ensuring data integrity and recovery capabilities.

WAL files serve as a fundamental mechanism for PostgreSQL's transactional model. When a change is made to the database, instead of immediately writing it to the data files on disk, PostgreSQL first writes the change to the WAL files in a sequential manner. This process, known as logging, ensures that modifications are recorded before they are applied to the main data files, making transactions durable even in the event of system failures.
